scope: Stationary distributions of monotone Markov chains on a finite grid: summation by parts, first-order stochastic dominance and expectations of monotone functions, monotone kernels preserving FOSD and shrinking the Kolmogorov distance; existence of a least stationary distribution by monotone iteration (Hopenhayn-Prescott), uniqueness and global stability under the monotone mixing condition via an m-step contraction (Bhattacharya-Lee), monotone comparative statics of stationary distributions; asset chains induced by saving rules with i.i.d. income, monotone when the rule is, and aggregate assets increasing in the saving rule.
source: Hopenhayn and Prescott (1992); Bhattacharya and Lee (1988); Kamihigashi and Stachurski (2014); Huggett (1993); Aiyagari (1994).
